provenance.source: Yahoo Finance chart API (query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart), monthly interval

fields.close: Month-end closing price in the listing currency, adjusted for splits but not for dividends (Yahoo's convention). Used for market capitalisation.
fields.adj_close: Close adjusted for splits and dividends. Used for every return calculation.

provenance.note: Historical month-end prices for a small, named universe, kept so the market-data engines and their tests run offline. Not a live feed: nothing in the application fetches prices at request time.

SPY.name: State Street SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust
